answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation is commonly referred to as the task of verbalizing a structured input also known as a table of values.

answer_2.quote: We considered BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BertScore dubbed as BScore, NLI, and RANK.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three evaluators from a Faculty of Law that assigned a score between 1 to 10, 1 corresponding to a generation completely off-track, and 10 being a perfect generation.
answer_4.guideline: score between 1 to 10, 1 corresponding to a generation completely off-track, and 10 being a perfect generation
